bug_semantics: In clusters configured to use Flannel's experimental Extension backend, the Kubernetes subnet manager turns the flannel.alpha.coreos.com/backend-data Node annotation into Lease.Attrs.BackendData. On remote lease add/remove events, the Extension backend JSON-decodes that attacker-controlled value, supplies it on stdin to the configured SubnetAddCommand or SubnetRemoveCommand, and executes the configured command through sh -c as the privileged flannel daemon. Thus a principal able to set Node annotations can feed malicious backend data into shell-based extension command processing on every watching flannel node, yielding cross-node root-level command execution. Non-Extension backends do not traverse this sink.
flaw_origin: Commit fb4a25e6089829ec68620f5a770da3fdfc41491e first introduced the entire Extension backend, including JSON decoding of remote BackendData, forwarding it to command stdin, and the sh -c SubnetAddCommand/SubnetRemoveCommand invocations. The later 7722da5eb9a08e3daf8ee5bd510c62b548dd2240 only allowed empty BackendData while retaining the already-vulnerable data-to-shell path, so it is not the BIC.
ai_marker: Absent. `git cat-file commit fb4a25e6089829ec68620f5a770da3fdfc41491e` shows human author and committer Tom Denham <tom@tomdee.co.uk>, one parent, a PGP signature, and only the message `backend/extension: Introduce new extension backend` followed by `WIP`; it has no Co-authored-by, Generated-with, AI-tool, or bot marker. This conclusion uses the BIC commit object only.
evidence: First-party advisory GHSA-vchx-5pr6-ffx2 / CVE-2026-32241 identifies the Extension-only BackendData annotation-to-command path, affected range <=0.28.1, first patched 0.28.2, and direct fix 08bc9a4c990ae785d2fcb448f4991b58485cd26a. In the validated clone, `git grep -n 'BackendData\|backend-data' v0.8.0 -- subnet/kube` shows v0.8.0:subnet/kube/kube.go defining `flannel.alpha.coreos.com/backend-data` at line 55 and assigning that Node annotation to `l.Attrs.BackendData` at line 294. `git show fb4a25e6089829ec68620f5a770da3fdfc41491e -- backend/extension/extension.go backend/extension/extension_network.go` shows both files created: event handlers unmarshal `evt.Lease.Attrs.BackendData`, pass the resulting string as stdin, and call `runCmd(..., "sh", "-c", n.subnetAddCommand)` or the remove equivalent; `runCmd` uses exec.Command, writes stdin through StdinPipe, and runs with flannel's privileges. `git log -L 70,136:backend/extension/extension_network.go 7722da5eb9a08e3daf8ee5bd510c62b548dd2240` reaches fb4a25e6089829ec68620f5a770da3fdfc41491e as the creation of those vulnerable handlers and shows 7722da5eb9a08e3daf8ee5bd510c62b548dd2240 merely restructuring the same path. Cross-check `git log --all -S'"sh", "-c", n.subnetAddCommand' -- backend/extension/extension_network.go pkg/backend/extension/extension_network.go` returns only the BIC addition and the 08bc9a4c990ae785d2fcb448f4991b58485cd26a removal. Direct parent proof: `git cat-file commit fb4a25e6089829ec68620f5a770da3fdfc41491e` names parent 008a58373bff2a28bd4b8d603d24844733c55e41, and `git diff --name-status 008a58373bff2a28bd4b8d603d24844733c55e41 fb4a25e6089829ec68620f5a770da3fdfc41491e -- backend/extension/extension.go backend/extension/extension_network.go` reports both files as A, proving the path is absent in the immediate parent. Release boundary: `git diff --name-status v0.7.1 v0.8.0-rc1 -- backend/extension/extension.go backend/extension/extension_network.go` reports both files added; v0.8.0-rc1 is b366263cac7bfe11b4872225afc4f80f5d9b259d and the first stable containing the feature is v0.8.0 at 6bbf8bf4923f7185465f46ca09d83667938c4993. The vulnerable Extension path persists through v0.28.1 at 5b6fc3ae0bf7ce3abbffef72c1bd3e60cda58556. `git show 08bc9a4c990ae785d2fcb448f4991b58485cd26a` shows the direct fix removing all four sh -c invocations, tokenizing configured commands, expanding variables into literal argv, and invoking exec.Command without a shell. `git diff v0.28.1 v0.28.2 -- pkg/backend/extension/extension.go pkg/backend/extension/extension_network.go` reproduces that fix across the release boundary; v0.28.2 is 7be627deb7794ed2f749ab9d6e06e60df5b362cf and contains the direct fix.
reasoning: The vulnerability-causing primitive is the Extension backend's original composition of remotely sourced BackendData with privileged shell-based add/remove commands. Both blame and function history may visually emphasize the 2017 empty-data adjustment, but the exact shell-invocation pickaxe and the original creation patch prove that the unsafe path already existed in fb4a25e6089829ec68620f5a770da3fdfc41491e; its parent lacks the Extension implementation entirely. The BIC is an ordinary one-parent feature commit rather than a move, merge, revert, release commit, or reconstructable squash, so no decomposition is needed. The direct corrective commit is the advisory-referenced 08bc9a4c990ae785d2fcb448f4991b58485cd26a, included in v0.28.2 and absent from v0.28.1. Because the BIC's raw commit object has only a human identity and no AI attribution or bot signal, the required BIC-only classification is NOT_AI regardless of any later history.
